description: Return the column contract for customs_check: the accepted field names, every alias each field answers to (for example 品名 / goodsName, 币制 / currency), and the header-level fields. Call this first when assembling a ledger, because a column name the reader does not recognise is silently dropped and the corresponding rule then reports nothing. Read-only, no parameters, no network, no writes.
name: customs_schema
title: Show the ledger column contract
